## Animato v1.7.3 — Facade `no_std` Fix

Animato v1.7.3 is a focused patch release that makes the `animato` facade
itself `no_std`-capable. It resolves the failure reported through
[scenix #21](https://github.com/AarambhDevHub/scenix/issues/21): with
`std` disabled, the facade always compiled as a `std` crate and could not
build for bare-metal targets, forcing `no_std` consumers onto the
sub-crates even when the facade features they enabled were `no_std`-safe.

### Highlights

- The facade `lib.rs` now declares `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]`,
  matching the sub-crates it re-exports.
- `animato --no-default-features` (core only) and
  `animato --no-default-features --features tween,spring` both compile for
  `thumbv7m-none-eabi`.
- `animato --no-default-features --features tween,spring,physics,color`
  compiles for `thumbv7m-none-eabi` too.
- `timeline` and `path` remain `std`-only (unchanged from v1.7.2); their
  internal dependency trees enable `animato-core/std` on bare metal.
- The bare-metal lanes in `ci.yml` and `publish.yml` now include the
  facade itself, so it can no longer silently require `std`.
- No public API changed: `std`-mode users are untouched, and `no_std`
  consumers that used the sub-crates directly may now use the facade.

### Building for bare metal

```toml
[dependencies]
animato = { version = "1.7.3", default-features = false, features = ["tween", "spring"] }
```

```sh
rustup target add thumbv7m-none-eabi
cargo check -p animato --no-default-features --features tween,spring --target thumbv7m-none-eabi
```

### Scenix integration

`scenix-animato` (the scenix facade bridge) depends on
`animato = "1.7.3"` with only `tween`/`spring` enabled, so the earlier
scenario compiles for `thumbv7m-none-eabi` exactly like the scenix
one-liner above.

---

_All workspace crates are versioned together at `1.7.3` in this release._
